description: This file defines the implementation of the NarratorAnnouncementHostFactory class, which manages the creation and selection of narrator announcement hosts such as NotificationHost and LiveRegionHost, based on availability and OS version.

classes.name: NarratorAnnouncementHostFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for initializing, registering, and providing narrator announcement hosts based on OS version and host availability.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the factory by registering hosts and setting the host producer.

methods.name: RegisterHosts
methods.description: Registers the available announcement hosts, prioritizing NotificationHost over LiveRegionHost.

methods.name: GetHostProducer
methods.description: Returns the first available narrator announcement host.

methods.name: MakeHost
methods.description: Creates and returns a new host instance from the host producer.
